errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie, die die Handelsbilanz darstellt
errors.evidence: The blue line represents 'Importe (linke Skala)', not the Handelsbilanz (Saldo). The Handelsbilanz is represented by the bars, not a line.
The blue line (Importe) starts at approximately 200 in 2020, not -150. The value -150 is not visible on the left or right y-axis for the blue line at 2020.
The blue line ends at approximately 350 in 2023, not 300.
The blue line does not reach -175 at any point; it remains above 150 throughout. The value -175 is not associated with the blue line.

errors.text_span: Die braune Linie, die die Exporte darstellt
errors.evidence: The line representing Exporte is red, not brown.
The red line (Exporte) starts at approximately 100 in 2020, not 150.
The red line (Exporte) ends at approximately 175 in 2023, not 300.

errors.text_span: Die violette Linie, die die Importe darstellt
errors.evidence: The line representing Importe is blue, not purple or violet.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei ca. 100 bei 2020 und steigt an auf ca. 225 bei 2023
errors.evidence: The blue line (Importe) starts at 200 in 2020 and ends at 350 in 2023, not 100 and 225. The values 100 and 225 correspond more closely to the red line (Exporte).

errors.text_span: wobei sie während der gesamten Zeitspanne sowohl oberhalb als auch unterhalb der Handelsbilanz liegt
errors.evidence: The Handelsbilanz is represented by bars, not a line, so it cannot be directly compared as 'above or below' the lines. This description misrepresents the structure of the chart.
The description omits the bars representing the 'Saldo (rechte Skala)', which are a critical visual feature of the chart.
The description does not mention the trend of the bars (Saldo), which start shorter in 2020 and become longer over time.
The red line (Exporte) does not have triangular markers; it is a solid line without markers.

errors.text_span: zeigt einige Schwankungen in der Zeit und erreicht einen Tiefststand von -175 bei 2021 und einen Höchststand von ca. 275 bei 2022
errors.evidence: The description refers to 'some fluctuations' and specific values (-175, 275) without clarifying which line or element these values correspond to.
